lines.text: I want to see humans suffer!
Let it be known: I despise vegetables!
I wanna win a Nobel Prize!
Just as I expected, you're no fun...
Hey, where'd you run off to? I'm bored over here.
I'm not picking up any scent of blood here.
Human! Take me to my quarters.
All humans will kneel before me!
Ohh! How did you do this?
I can feel myself getting stronger!
I hope the next gift will be someone tasty.
You! Come with me. We're going to eat.
You're a good egg, so I won't eat you.
Do you have something to say?
You can clean up after me.
Me! Power! The strongest in the world!
What's happening... I can barely even move my fingers...
